iris-voltage.$description: Iris Voltage — Brand accent for primary CTAs, link color, accent words inside serif headlines, and the thin violet underlines/arrows on navigation and article links

midnight-vault.$description: Midnight Vault — Hero and footer canvas — the deep navy that frames the largest serif headlines and the top of the page

pure-ink.$description: Pure Ink — Primary text, default hairlines, and the 1px borders that separate every card, section, and image

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on violet, and inverse text on the dark hero

graphite-slate.$description: Graphite Slate — Cool desaturated border and secondary text — sits between Pure Ink and Midnight Vault when a softer line or muted label is needed

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Light neutral action fill for buttons on dark surfaces.

tiempos-headline.$description: Serif used exclusively for headlines and section titles. The single weight (400) plus aggressive negative tracking gives headings a literary, almost newspaper-editorial quality that contrasts with the cyber-security subject matter. Letter-spacing tightens to -0.02em at every size, pulling the serifs into a dense, confident block.

matter.$description: Workhorse sans for body copy, navigation, buttons, captions, and card meta. Weight 400 is default; 500 is used sparingly for emphasis in labels and small UI text. Generous line-heights (1.4–1.6) keep body copy breathable on a spacious canvas. Letter-spacing -0.01em at body sizes gives it a tighter, more engineered feel than a typical system sans.
